outcome.P1: CONFIRMED, all four clauses. Stride 1: the site energy (seed mean 0.00185) and the tilted spline (0.00270) are below 0.02 in 16/16 seeds. Stride-4 / stride-1: 25.2 for the site energy and 14.2 for the spline, at least 2 in 16/16 seeds (E36's two seeds: 18-30).
outcome.P2: UNRESOLVED, as registered: the MDN selected its last checkpoint (2000) in 15 of 16 stride-4 fits (and 16/16 at strides 1 and 2); none of the 48 converged. The registered rule therefore does not allow a verdict. The numbers are one-sided in the clause's direction: the MDN's stride-4 risk is 0.0199 against 0.0403 for the site energy and 0.0362 for the spline (ratios 0.495 and 0.551), below the site energy in 16 of 16 seeds (range 0.0095-0.0227 against 0.0393-0.0408). Because a capped fit is still improving, 0.0199 is an UPPER bound on the MDN's converged risk, so more budget can only widen the margin; extending the ladder from 400 (E36) to 2000 updates took the MDN's stride-4 seed mean from 0.058 (E36, two seeds) to 0.020 (sixteen seeds); on the same seeds 0-1 the change was 0.0229 -> 0.0210 and 0.0933 -> 0.0223.
outcome.P3: CONFIRMED at all three strides: the mixture's seed-mean risk is 1.026, 1.008 and 1.008 times E36's frozen floor (0.0975, 0.1578, 0.2347) at strides 1, 2, 4.
outcome.unregistered: Seed means of the clean risk (site energy / spline / mixture / MDN) at stride 1: 0.0019 / 0.0027 / 0.100 / 0.0103; stride 2: 0.0108 / 0.0101 / 0.159 / 0.0104; stride 4: 0.0403 / 0.0362 / 0.237 / 0.0199. At stride 4 the spline is 10% BELOW the site energy (mean ratio 0.90), the first place the exactly specified 5-parameter kernel is not the best of the gradient class: K^s is no longer in the tilted-walk class, which is the misspecification the stride protocol was designed to create. Despite its cap, the MDN is the best arm at stride 4 (16/16 seeds) and at stride 2 in 13 of 16 seeds and by median (0.0084 against the spline's 0.0100), but not by seed mean (0.01039 against the spline's 0.01008, because of seed 4 at 0.0353). At stride 1 it is the worst of the three non-mixture arms in 16/16 seeds: 5.59 times the site energy as a ratio of seed means (6.47 as the mean of per-seed ratios); the mixture (0.100) is about ten times worse than the MDN.
